title: Unit – 4 : Session – 5 : SLO – 2  |  Logic Programming — Rule Evaluation
sections: Given:  likes(john, X) :- food(X).   with facts  food(pizza).  food(burger).
Explanation: the rule succeeds for every X that satisfies food(X). Prolog first unifies X with pizza; on asking for more solutions (;) it backtracks and returns burger. Both values satisfy the query.
